targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.flw_speed) AS "usm/flw_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.frw_speed) AS "usm/frw_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.blw_speed) AS "usm/blw_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.brw_speed) AS "usm/brw_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.wheel_speed) AS "usm/wheel_speed [rad/s]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_ride_height) AS "csm/fl_ride_height [mm]", AVG(dynamics.fr_ride_height) AS "csm/fr_ride_height [mm]", AVG(dynamics.bl_ride_height) AS "csm/bl_ride_height [mm]", AVG(dynamics.br_ride_height) AS "csm/br_ride_height [mm]", AVG(dynamics.ride_height) AS "usm/ride_height [mm]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_strain_gauge_v) AS "csm/fl_strain_gauge_v [V]", AVG(dynamics.fr_strain_gauge_v) AS "csm/fr_strain_gauge_v [V]", AVG(dynamics.bl_strain_gauge_v) AS "csm/bl_strain_gauge_v [V]", AVG(dynamics.br_strain_gauge_v) AS "csm/br_strain_gauge_v [V]", AVG(dynamics.fl_sus_pot_v) AS "csm/fl_sus_pot_v [V]", AVG(dynamics.fr_sus_pot_v) AS "csm/fr_sus_pot_v [V]", AVG(dynamics.bl_sus_pot_v) AS "csm/bl_sus_pot_v [V]", AVG(dynamics.br_sus_pot_v) AS "csm/br_sus_pot_v [V]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.accel_pedal_travel) AS "vcu/accel_pedal_travel [%]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.steer_col_angle) AS "vcu/steer_col_angle [deg]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_sprung_accel[1]) AS "csm/fl_sprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fl_sprung_accel[2]) AS "csm/fl_sprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fl_sprung_accel[3]) AS "csm/fl_sprung_accel_z [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fr_sprung_accel[1]) AS "csm/fr_sprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fr_sprung_accel[2]) AS "csm/fr_sprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fr_sprung_accel[3]) AS "csm/fr_sprung_accel_z [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.bl_sprung_accel[1]) AS "csm/bl_sprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.bl_sprung_accel[2]) AS "csm/bl_sprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.bl_sprung_accel[3]) AS "csm/bl_sprung_accel_z [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.br_sprung_accel[1]) AS "csm/br_sprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.br_sprung_accel[2]) AS "csm/br_sprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.br_sprung_accel[3]) AS "csm/br_sprung_accel_z [m/s^2]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_unsprung_accel[1]) AS "usm/fl_unsprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fl_unsprung_accel[2]) AS "usm/fl_unsprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fl_unsprung_accel[3]) AS "usm/fl_unsprung_accel_z [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fr_unsprung_accel[1]) AS "usm/fr_unsprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fr_unsprung_accel[2]) AS "usm/fr_unsprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.fr_unsprung_accel[3]) AS "usm/fr_unsprung_accel_z [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.bl_unsprung_accel[1]) AS "usm/bl_unsprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.bl_unsprung_accel[2]) AS "usm/bl_unsprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.bl_unsprung_accel[3]) AS "usm/bl_unsprung_accel_z [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.br_unsprung_accel[1]) AS "usm/br_unsprung_accel_x [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.br_unsprung_accel[2]) AS "usm/br_unsprung_accel_y [m/s^2]", AVG(dynamics.br_unsprung_accel[3]) AS "usm/br_unsprung_accel_z [m/s^2]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
